figures.caption: Analysis workflow and the separate roles of training, validation, calibration and final evaluation partitions.
Distributions of six input variables and the response across training, IID test and thickness-shift partitions.
Univariate projections of the response against the six training inputs. Each panel uses the same 1,200 rows, selected as every fourth row of the 4,800-row training partition.
Pearson correlations among inputs and response for all 4,800 training rows. Correlation is descriptive, not a feature-selection criterion.
MGRE architecture: a positive mechanics reference, a smooth global residual trend with pairwise spline interactions, probabilistically gated local residual correction and training-support taper.
IID performance of the nonconstant comparison methods. Bars show the mean and error bars the sample SD across three training seeds.
Observed-versus-predicted stroke for MGRE, tuned SVR and legacy MGRE. Points use fixed mean-across-seed predictions.
Seed-specific validation and evaluation errors; deterministic tuned SVR repeats exactly across the three seed labels.
Paired differences with 95% bootstrap intervals from 1,000 row resamples using seed 43 and fixed mean-across-seed predictions. Negative differences favor MGRE.
Learning curves on fixed nested subsets. Lines and bands show means and sample SDs over three seeds; all model settings remain frozen.
Removal experiments for the selected MGRE modules. Every variant retains the full-model hyperparameters; no ablation is retuned.
Seed40 support and gate diagnostics: attenuation beyond training bounds, local residual corrections and maximum Gaussian responsibilities.
Median local prediction derivatives with 10th–90th percentile ranges at 300 fixed validation inputs. These responses are descriptive sensitivities, not causal effects.
Predictive error and interval behavior in IID and shifted evaluation. The dashed line marks nominal 90% coverage; lower interval score jointly rewards sharpness and penalizes misses.
Seed40 prediction intervals for 100 evenly spaced order statistics from each final partition. Ordering is for visualization only.
Thickness-stratified interval coverage and width, averaged across training seeds. Quartiles are descriptive and do not influence model selection.
